mapper.insert: insert into student (user_id, student_no, name, gender, phone, college, major, class_name, grade, difficulty_level, bank_card, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{userId}, #{studentNo}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{college}, #{major}, #{className}, #{grade}, #{difficultyLevel}, #{bankCard}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select: select id, user_id, student_no, name, gender, phone, college, major, class_name, grade, difficulty_level, bank_card, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user from student where status = 1 order by id asc

select s.id, s.user_id, s.student_no, s.name, s.gender, s.phone, s.college, s.major, s.class_name, s.grade, s.difficulty_level, s.bank_card, s.status, s.create_time, s.update_time, s.create_user, s.update_user, u.username from student s left join sys_user u on s.user_id = u.id
and s.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and s.student_no like concat('%', #{studentNo}, '%')
and s.college like concat('%', #{college}, '%')
order by s.create_time desc, s.id desc
